upcoming.title: 8MM Live: SUNSET IMAGES
upcoming.body:
8MM Live: Sunset Images

Doors: 19:00

Showtime: 20:45

Aftershow dj tbc : 22:00

In the depths of Mexico City, a maelstrom of sound has been brewing, Sunset Images, a sonic entity - fueled by the unyielding passion of Samuel Osorio - has transcended the influences of krautrock, shoegaze, and punk into a layered soundscape of dissonance, cathartic release, and emotional depth.

With a growing reputation for their intense live performances, Sunset Images has shared stages with notable bands, toured extensively across multiple continents and released a series of EPs and a LP that confront violence, racism and misogyny, and has dealt with subjects like loneliness, anger and desperation.

This journey has lead them into their highly anticipated debut with Dedstrange, the label founded by none other than the mastermind behind A Place To Bury Strangers and the FX pedal company Death by Audio, Oliver Ackermann, who sought out and brought them into the Dedstrange tribe of sonic outcasts, where Sunset Images has found the perfect home and only label that could match their vision for massively distorted and inextricable sound.

Their new album, "Oscilador", released on January 23, 2026, is a sonic resistance manifesto that embodies the perpetual cycle of birth, decay, chaos, and resolution that rules our world.

upcoming.title: 8MM FEST DAY 1
upcoming.body:
On November 13 and 14, 2026, 8MM Fest returns for two nights across three of Berlin's most distinctive spaces: 8MM Bar in Prenzlauer Berg, ACUD MACHT NEU in Mitte, and the Zionskirche.

Deliberately kept lean, the festival channels 8MM Bar's two-decade reputation for curating the best of the world's underground into a compact, Mitte-centered weekend. This year collaborating on the stages with long running legendary concert series - Shameless / Limitless, New Colossus Festival from New York City, and experimental Berlin collectives - Salon Oblique and Tranceversal Voices.

upcoming.title: 8MM Live: Black Maracas
upcoming.body:
8MM Live: Black Maracas 19.11.2026

Doors: 19:00

Showtime: 20:45

Aftershow dj set tbc 22:00

Over the last five years, Black Maracas have built a strong live reputation across Europe and the Americas, despite how difficult it is to categorize their music: within a single concert, they can naturally move between fuzz, blues, garage rock, and psychedelia. In recent months, they have toured Europe, South America, and the United States, performing at major festivals such as Madrid’s Mad Cool Festival, Seattle’s Freakout Festival, and Austin’s Levitation—two of the most renowned rock events in the world. They have shared the bill with artists who have influenced the band, including Night Beats, The Dandy Warhols, The Black Angels, and The Brian Jonestown Massacre.

In 2026, the band opens a new chapter with “Dilly Child Early Mournings,” a record far more intimate than its predecessor and created from a different perspective. It is no longer angry at the world; what it conveys is not rage, but grief that ultimately leads to acceptance. While it continues to explore themes of frustration, personal experiences, disillusionment, and lost love, it does so with a gentler outlook. This results in more carefully crafted lyrics and more harmonious music, drawing from the traditions of Americana, folk, and country.

Luft are a Berlin-based five-piece led by former TOY frontman, Tom Dougall and joined by Ani Mijatović, Sam Davies, Rob Henderson and Aaron Singh. In covert operation for some time following the dissolution of Dougall’s former group, Luft first appeared in the wider public eye in October 2025 via their appearance on Tough Love’s 20th anniversary compilation, Don’t Do Anything Important With Anybody Else.

They now begin to plot their own course with the release of the Luke Haines (of The Auteurs/Black Box Recorder) produced debut single, ‘Something On My Mind’, a midnight-dwelling, romance-baiting reverie that envisages the faded glamour of a lost Soho and all the attendant psychodrama that might entail.

‘Something On My Mind’ is released as a limited 12” (edition of 100) on 24th July, backed by vinyl-only B-side ‘God Helmet’ and housed in a hand-stamped sleeve. Further Luft sounds and live shows are to follow later in 2026.
Art by @animijatovic

past.title: 8MM + Shameless Limitless pres: DEVON REXI
past.body:
8MM and Shameless / Limitless present: DEVON REXI - 7th October

Doors: 19:00

Showtime: 20:45

Aftershow dj set tbc 22:00

Following two lauded EPs on cult label South of North—Tambal (2022) and Biya Ba Man (2024)—Amsterdam-based interdimensional dub group Devon Rexi prepare to release their much-anticipated debut album, recorded by and featuring the elusive 5 Gate Temple devotee, musician and producer John T. Gast.

The group is formed by a core trio of Nicola Reverda (Nicolini) on drums and vocals, Nushin Naini on bass and vocals, and Goya van der Heyden (La Rat) on samples and effects. In this formation, they skirt and flirt around a motorik kraut-rock mentality with an indubiously dub-laden physicality and an uncategorisable sense of experimentation.

The shifted realities of Devon Rexi’s songs arrive like quantum conjurings, as if their frequencies are echoing from the furthest wormholes of space. As much as they create something fantastical and yet-unheard, their priority is in understanding vulnerability and friction, reality and fragility, mythologies and everyday resistances. They do this artfully and honestly through an almost deceptively simple arrangement of percussion, bass, and melody.

Doors: 19:00

Aftershow dj TBC

Morgan Garrett has long been a stalwart presence in independent American experimental music. One of those souls reared in the borderlands where rural Appalachia begins to melt into the Midwest, where the shadows of DuPont Chemical and Perdue Pharma lay over thousands of lives. Reaching for any sonic tools without pretense of recapitulating any musical tradition, his work evades the confines of genre, but has found a home amidst both the more personal and off-kilter visions from Americana noise and industrial music, and the fringes of electronic music. Morgan's live performances are notoriously potent and surreal. The 2024 release of his acclaimed debut LP Purity on Orange Milk Records underscores the commitment to his craft and to the wider world of challenging electronic music. "The Mirror” is Morgan’s follow-up to Purity, and his most realized project to date.

8MM Live: The Third Sound

Doors: 19:00

Showtime: 20:45

Aftershow dj set HALBERG (Third Sound / Brian Jonestown Massacre) 22:00

Ever evolving Berlin based The Third Sound are back with their hypnotic blend of psychedelia and drone infused post punk. After a successful Australian tour in early 2026, the cards were reshuffled once again, and with a brand-new line up the band has begun working on a new album (their 7th), due to be released next year.

Before finishing the record, there will be run of shows this autumn testing out some of the new material, mixed with songs from previous albums, many of which becoming firm favourites with audiences everywhere during their live sets in recent years.

Their well-received most recent LP ´Most Perfect Solitude , was released on Fuzz Club Records in 2024 followed by stand-alone single ´Remedy which dropped earlier this year.

After touring extensively the last few years, both with The Third Sound and as a guitarist for the Brian Jonestown Massacre, the Icelandic musician Hákon Aðalsteinsson is ready to take The Third Sound in new directions alongside recently joined fellow Icelander and BJM member Hallberg Daði Hallbergsson, Francis Broek (Goblyns) and Mike Denton (formerly of The Lucid Dream).

past.title: 8MM + Shameless / Limitless pres: Meril Wubslin
past.body:
8MM and S/L warmly welcome the eternally blunted, Bongo Joe signed Brussels trio Meril Wubslin for a smoked out night of psych drone.

Tickets: https://shorturl.at/dm2Qn

--

Meril Wubslin are a Belgian-Swiss Lo-Fi / Folk / Sci-Fi / Psyche / Trance contemporary music group, formed in 2010 by Christian Garcia-Gaucher. Improvisation and repetition are essential elements of their performances, with tracks that last five minutes on the record extending up to twenty minutes live.

Their debut album, "-1-," was released in 2010 on Saïko.

In 2016, their second album, "Sinon," was released on Cheptel Records. The record marked a new chapter for the band in that all vocals were in French.

The band began releasing with Bongo Joe records in 2021, in the form of LP "Alors quoi”. The reception to the records was excellent, with acclaim from international press. The band toured the record extensively, including a stop at the acclaimed Le Guess Who? Festival in Utrecht.

The band recorded their fourth album ("Faire ça”, released on Bongo Joe), in London, alongside Kwake Bass, a central figure in the southeast London music scene and collaborator with Kae Tempest, Tirzah, Coby Sey, Mica Levi, etc.

past.body:
8MM Live: ELLiS D

Doors: 19:00

Showtime: 20:45

Aftershow dj TBC

Imagine if David Byrne and David Bowie merged in a bizarre scene from a 1980s sci-fi bonanza. Then imagine if that new beast wandered into a goth club during that same era. Half glam rock, half neurotic punk but fully stylistic in its musical carnage. The result is ELLiS-D.

An explosion of whiplash riffs, psychedelic break downs, false endings and rip-roaring returns, ‘Drifting’ distills the essence of ELLiS·D’s “exhilarating” (Far Out) live show into a frenetic 7 minute voyage – A live show that last year ushered in two nationwide headline tours, festival appearances at Kendal Calling and Left of The Dial and a two-week tour of Europe with Fat Dog, to be followed up with a second leg this spring.

Sophomore EP Spill on Crafting Room Recordings is written and performed entirely by ELLiS·D himself (aka Ellis Dickson) at Hackney Road studios with Shuta Shinoda (Hot Chip, Jenny Beth), ‘Drifting’ offers the closing track of ELLiS·D’s upcoming Spill EP, a seven song jetstream of rocket-fuelled, goth-tinged glam-punk, infested with 21st century paranoia:

Supported by BBC Radio 6Music (New Music Fix, Tom Robinson, Emily Pilbeam), Radio X (John Kennedy), So Young Magazine, NME, Far Out, Hard of Hearing and Rodeo.

Known for their wounded country and barreling noise-rock sound, Twine was formed in Adelaide, Australia, in 2021, initially as a solo outlet for Tom Katsaras’ experiments in brash, country-inflected rock. Their latest EP, Deer in the Headlights, follows the Australian Music Prize-nominated debut New Old Horse (2024), a tender yet eruptive exploration of identity and wayward relationships. Now based in Melbourne, the band has evolved into an entirely new form, further exploring the tender relationship between noise and vulnerability alongside new members Xanthe Rook (Recitals), James Dimick (Craning), and Vindi Ferguson (kisses). Known for their exhilarating live shows, Twine has supported Unwound (USA), The Hard Quartet (USA), and Mclusky (UK), and has played sold-out shows across Australia and New Zealand, with festival appearances at Laneway, Camp A Low Hum, BIGSOUND, and SXSW Sydney.
